# Build status

The one file that says where the build is. Every run reads it first and updates it after every step. How a run works: [RUNBOOK.md](RUNBOOK.md).

- **Branch:** `build/stage-1`
- **Gate:** `npm run verify` and the browser checks. GitHub's machines run them on every pushed branch (read the result with `node scripts/github-check.mjs`). While that holds, GitHub cannot check a lane, so a lane whose newest commit GitHub has not passed is gated HERE, by the lead, one lane at a time, after its catch-up merge: `npm run verify`, `npm run test:stats:browser` and `npm run test:web:browser` in the lane, each through `node scripts/heavy.mjs --` (the runbook's fallback for when GitHub cannot check a lane); GitHub then checks the build branch after the landing, and that result is what lets `main` move. Helpers in lanes run only `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck` and the test files of what changed.

Since 2026-11-13 the live tracker is built from one fixed commit named in `.github/workflows/demo-pages.yml`, so the script moves `main` whenever the move is a plain fast-forward, GitHub's checks have passed on that exact commit, and no workflow that reaches the live tracker differs from `main`'s; games do not hold it back any more. Changing what the tracker is published from is a release: only the lead, in a session the founder started, with `--release-tracker`, and never from 24 hours before a game to 4 hours after. Never push to `main` any other way, and never by hand in a run.

Nobody looks for a way round a refusal, so FROM THIS MACHINE NO LANE BRANCH IS PUSHED AND NONE IS DELETED ON GITHUB until the founder says in the chat that lane branches may be pushed and deleted ("Needs the founder", first item); helpers are told not to run `push-lane.mjs`. When the founder has said so: a builder pushes ITS OWN LANE with `node scripts/push-lane.mjs` and only with it (the script refuses every other branch and forces nothing) and waits with `node scripts/wait-for-github.mjs`, as on the first computer; the build branch, `main` and deleting branches stay the lead's. Never push or merge to `main` by hand: it is the branch the live Al-Hadi tracker site at `mrsaiyed.github.io/league-platform/` is published from, and that site is in use for real games.
